# HexPiece 3.5.1

The Ito Ito no Mi's Haki Awakening tentacles, made massive. Not tested in game yet: the build and the tests pass, and the tentacles
were checked in previews (third and first person, out of the ground and out of a tree, from the moment they burst out to when they
sink back).

**Awakening with Armament Haki (M): the tentacles**
- Each tentacle is now a giant rope of white string: three thick strands twisted round each other, shading lilac-purple at the
  edges, about one and a half blocks across where it bursts out of the ground and narrowing toward its tip. Before, it was a thin
  see-through lattice of strings.
- It bursts out of the ground with cords of string splaying from its foot, rises leaning back like a cobra, writhes slowly, and
  arches over onto its target.
- Its last stretch is Haki-black with a violet rim, ending in a flat black spear head in a violet glow that goes right through the
  creature it impales.
- Out of a tree, the trunk's top turns into the tentacle and cords of string wind down the trunk.
- When the creature is close to you, the tentacle now bursts out beside it instead of between you and it, so the big body never comes
  up under your feet or fills your view.
- It is no heavier to draw than the old one.
